article_summaries.title: SOE Super Fan Holidays
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post announcing the Super Fan Holidays sale, with Station Cash discounts for everyone and extra discounts for Free Realms members. The post gives the sale window and the discount percentages; the exact year is not shown, and the 'posted 6 months ago' age implies late 2010 relative to the June 2011 capture.
